title: EDI for Supplement Brands Entering Retail: Validate Item Numbers and Pack Configurations
summary: Validate retailer item numbers against the approved NetSuite package and case count before an Orderful order is accepted or a shipment document is built.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Retail EDI for supplement brands depends on an approved crosswalk between retailer item numbers and the exact nutrition product, package, and case configuration. Validate that relationship before accepting an order or building a shipment document. A matching flavor or serving count does not prove the retailer ordered the same sellable item.


Explore the complete[nutrition and supplements integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/nutrition-supplements) for the systems and processes around this guide.
